message:
Let me check if cbor2 is available, and also verify the CBOR structure:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>pip3 install cbor2 2>/dev/null; python3 -c "
import cbor2
payload = bytes([0xA2, 0x00, 0x64, 0x74, 0x65, 0x73, 0x74, 0x06, 0xA1, 0x11, 0xA1, 0x07, 0x82, 0x01, 0x00])
obj = cbor2.loads(payload)
print('Parsed CBOR:', obj)
print('Type:', type(obj))
"
</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
